stories.title: Revolut Outage Disrupts Payments and Banking Services as Google Cloud Reports London Issues
stories.description: Revolut suffered a major service outage on Tuesday, October 20, 2026, disrupting payments, cash withdrawals, and access to its banking app.

stories.title: Microsoft Targets Rogue AI Agents With Dynamic Permissions, Risk Scoring
stories.description: Microsoft says companies should treat AI agents as insiders, and is adding controls that grant access per task and tighten it as an agent’s risk rises.

stories.title: Hackers Target South Korean Banks With AI, Then Accidentally Expose Their Own Attack Tools

stories.title: ThreatBook Launches RedAgents AI Platform That Uses Multiple Hacking Agents to Find Security Flaws

stories.title: U.S. Government Bans DeepSeek AI and Orders Federal Agencies to Remove All Related Tools
stories.description: The U.S. Department of Homeland Security has ordered federal civilian agencies to stop buying DeepSeek products and remove related technology from their IT systems.

stories.title: 970,000 Medi-Cal Members Affected by Paradigm Healthcare Data Breach

stories.title: Hackers Hijack Five OVHcloud CLI Releases to Distribute Secret-Stealing Malware
stories.description: Attackers replaced OVHcloud CLI downloads across five GitHub releases with secret-stealing builds for up to 94 minutes on October 19.
